facts.text: Maria had a conversation with someone named David at an event, and he shared his story of hardship and difficult circumstances.

evidence.quote: Yeah, at the event, I had a conversation with someone named David. Hearing his story of hardship and how he ended up in difficult circumstances was so humbling.

facts.text: Maria linked David up with a nearby organization that offers housing and support for homeless individuals after their conversation.

evidence.quote: I talked to him afterwards and linked him up with a nearby organization that offers housing and support for homeless individuals.

facts.text: Maria mentioned that she had money problems when she was younger and had to rely on outside help from her aunt.

evidence.quote: When I was younger, we had some money problems and had to rely on outside help from out auntie.

facts.text: John mentioned that he started helping out with a food drive for folks who lost their jobs and shared a picture of himself at the food bank.

evidence.quote: I just started helping out with a food drive for folks who lost their jobs. Here's a picture of me at the food bank.
